title: Images of Trump kissing Natalie Harp went viral. They’re AI-generated fakes.

reports.title: Images of Trump kissing Natalie Harp went viral. They’re AI-generated fakes.

summary: AI-generated images that appeared to show U.S. President Donald Trump kissing White House aide Natalie Harp on a golf course spread widely on social media, and one post on X drew more than 10 million views. Forensic analysis and provenance checks found the circulating images were synthetic, and the White House described them as fake. The person who originally created the images was not identified.
title_en: Images of Trump kissing Natalie Harp went viral. They’re AI-generated fakes.
